title: DevOps Engineer
text:
Ironclad Robotics builds warehouse robots. Our DevOps team runs the fleet's cloud backend and the build systems that ship robot software.

Responsibilities
- Maintain CI/CD with GitLab CI and Bazel for C++ and Python codebases.
- Run services on AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3) defined with CloudFormation and Terraform.
- Containerize workloads with Docker and orchestrate with Kubernetes.
- Operate observability: ELK stack for logs, Prometheus for metrics, Sentry for errors.
- Harden systems: secure coding reviews, SSO and secrets management.
- Write automation in Python and Bash on Linux.

Requirements
- 3+ years in DevOps or platform engineering.
- Experience with networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS) and Nginx.
- Experience supporting embedded or robotics teams is a plus.
- Ability to travel to warehouses up to 10%.
